The actual website was far better. I recently downloaded the app because unfortunately its now the only way I can actual make use of if the pro subscription I recently purchased. The website was far better, it allowed users far more control over the images being generated and tbh, the images that it did generate were far more impressive. I downloaded this app expecting things to be the other way around, and was sadly very disappointed. The app removed the ability to pick custom poses, or even adjust the quality of the resulting images (At least not anywhere close to the same extent I was able to online.) Online allowed casual generations (at least for pro users) which is something I have yet to figure out how to do on this app, along with many other features that have kept me returning as a satisfied user of promptchanai. The one good thing I will say about this app is it’s far simpler to use, and it seems to require users to play around with it for less time, in order to get a decent understanding over how to use it.. But that’s probably due to the removal of the many aspects of prompchanai that made it so appealing.. And don’t even get me started on attempting to use this app on an ipad… At least on my cellphone I can still generate images. On my ipad all it does is eat my gems and literally puts out nothing. I honestly feel like i’ve been swindled. Had I known the website was going to enforce such drastic changes I would have never resubscribed While there do exist very few positives, my overall experience with this app has been incredibly frustrating. Unless some serious changes are made, this will very likely be the last time I subscribe.

New revenue for developers. Solid app but the only ways to get gems is to share the app (sorry but no thanks) or buy them (it’s better than most similar products & at a better price) but it could have another feature to benefit both parities 
As a task you could watch ads to earn gems, that way those who quit the app after the first free gems will keep producing revenue over time & those who already buy it don’t have to wait the longer time.
Also I was thinking about getting a subscription but I’m quite hesitant to because it says “advanced features” or “all features” but I’m not quite sure what that means. I saw that an ai bot was available but I’m not sure if gifs or videos are possible. If you could clarify that on the app that would probably encourage a lot more people to actually get it. 
Overall an amazing quality app but an ad system that gives gems in exchange for viewing advertisements & clarification on what the subscriptions provide would greatly benefit the experience & increase profit margins.
